summary_ja: 理研神戸地区のAI for Science用スーパーコンピュータ増強に伴う機械3.41億円、電気3.63億円の契約を追加しました。二契約の合計7.04億円をシステム総価格や一般単価とは扱わず、scopeと既設設備接続条件を明示します。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds RIKEN Kobe contracts of JPY 341 million for mechanical works and JPY 363 million for electrical works supporting an AI-for-Science supercomputer expansion. Their JPY 704 million sum is not treated as a total system price or general unit cost; scope and interfaces with existing infrastructure are explicit. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_ja: 神戸地区AIスーパーコンピュータ向け冷却3.41億円・電気3.63億円
items.name_en: JPY 341 million cooling and JPY 363 million electrical works for Kobe AI supercomputer
items.timing_ja: 契約期間2025年7月25日〜2026年3月31日
items.statement_ja: 理研の随意契約公表では、AI for Science用スーパーコンピュータ増強に伴う機械工事が税込3.41億円、電気工事が税込3.63億円です。機械工事は既存の量子HPC連携基盤向け冷却へfree cooling設備とpump等を増設し、電気工事は富岳にも接続された特別高圧受電設備から分岐して高圧受電設備と冷却電源を増強します。単純合計7.04億円はこの二契約だけの値であり、計算機、建屋既設設備、工事①、運転費を含む総事業費ではありません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN's published negotiated contracts list JPY 341 million including tax for mechanical works and JPY 363 million including tax for electrical works supporting an AI-for-Science supercomputer expansion. Mechanical work adds free cooling, pumps, and related systems to cooling for the quantum-HPC platform; electrical work branches from extra-high-voltage receiving equipment also serving Fugaku and expands high-voltage receiving and cooling power. The simple JPY 704 million sum covers only these two contracts, not the compute system, pre-existing building infrastructure, related project 1, or operating costs.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 高密度AI計算機の予算比較では、装置価格から独立した受変電・冷却・制御統合費と、既設設備への接続リスクを明示する実例です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This is direct evidence that high-density AI budgets must separate power-receiving, cooling, controls-integration costs, and risks of connecting to live infrastructure from the compute-system price.
adoption_conditions_ja: 工事額をIT装置価格やMW単価へ直接換算せず、scope、capacity、既設流用範囲を確認する。
計算機、network、storage、建屋、電気、機械、設計監理、運転費を別のcost ledgerで追跡する。
既存HPCI資源を止めずに施工・試運転する責任境界と計画停電を契約条件に含める。
adoption_conditions_en: Do not convert contract values directly into IT-system prices or cost per MW; verify scope, capacity, and reuse of existing assets.
Track compute, network, storage, building, electrical, mechanical, design supervision, and operations in separate cost ledgers.
Include responsibility boundaries and planned outages for construction and commissioning without disrupting existing HPCI resources.
